conditions.b2b_1st: team plays the next day, did not play the previous day
conditions.rested: 1+ days off before, no game next day (season openers excluded)

pooled_2023_27.label: All four seasons (2023-24 to 2026-27 to date)

definitions.scopes: timespan ids = scope keys. A player's numbers in a timespan pool his games from every season in it. Legacy scope names (2025-26, 2026-27, combined) are aliases of 2025_26, 2026_27 and pooled_2023_26 (default); note 'combined' now means 2023-24..2025-26, not 2025-27.
definitions.segments: nested by PPG rank within the timespan among players with >= min_games_floor games: top100/top50/top25/top10 (each contains the next); 'all' = everyone. Tiebreak PPG, then games, then lower player_id. Per player: seasons[ts].segment = {gp, ppg, ppg_rank, meets_floor, segments:[ids]}.
definitions.qualifies: >= 3 games in each condition of the comparison
definitions.raw: player's mean pts in A minus mean pts in B
definitions.se: sd * sqrt(1/n_a + 1/n_b), sd = the player's game-to-game pts SD over all his games in the timespan
definitions.ci95: raw +/- t(0.975, df = player's games in timespan - 1) * se
definitions.shrunk: empirical-Bayes estimate: league + w*(raw - league), w = tau^2/(tau^2+se^2); tau^2 = DerSimonian-Laird between-player variance across qualifying players (same timespan & comparison); shrinks toward the displayed league pts_mean
definitions.percentile: rank of shrunk among all qualifying league players (0-100, midrank)
definitions.p_q: p = two-sided normal p of z; q = Benjamini-Hochberg q-value across qualifying players in the same timespan & comparison
definitions.flag: <above|below>_league_strong when q < 0.1; <above|below>_league_watch when |z| >= 2.5 (nominal, not multiplicity-adjusted); else null
definitions.league: baseline over ALL players with games (not only app players): comparisons = mean/median of qualifying players' raw; conditions = mean of player condition means (players with >= 3 games in it); by_segment = the same qualifying players restricted to a nested segment (raw means; shrinkage baseline stays the whole league)
definitions.minutes_per36: raw differences only (minutes CI built the same way as pts); shrinkage/z/flag apply to pts
definitions.games: regular season (002) incl. NBA Cup group/knockout; no Cup final, playoffs, play-in; minutes > 0 only; all four seasons 2023-24..2026-27

ranking_note: by_shrunk ties break on raw, then player_id. shrunk_is_flat = league tau < 0.1 pt: individual effects are indistinguishable from noise and every shrunk value sits within a few hundredths of the league mean, so prefer by_raw with CIs for display
ranking_population: app players (data/betting_points.json) that qualify; percentiles/baselines use all league players

caveats: 2026-27 is a very small sample; most players do not qualify and very few qualify for B2B comparisons yet.
'watch' flags are nominal: with ~400-800 players per comparison, ~1.2% would reach |z|>=2.5 by chance. Only 'strong' (FDR q<0.1) survives multiple testing.
Observational: rest decisions are not random; players held out are not in the data.
